Actions are well-prioritized and directly match the preferred action (restore/fix the region-header mapping, A1/A2), include reasonable validation and monitoring steps (A3, A4), and appropriately downgrade CPU to a non-control-point (A5) without weakening any protective control. No structural or secondary-flag issues identified.
